patch_description: Replace the subtractive covariance update with the numerically robust Joseph form. The current `P - KHP` expression can gradually lose positive-semidefiniteness through floating-point cancellation, particularly when adaptive measurement/process variances produce aggressive gains. Joseph form preserves covariance consistency, while explicit symmetry restoration, variance floors, and cross-covariance bounding prevent invalid covariance states. This permits stable adaptive tracking without spurious gain excursions that can cause false slope reversals.
